tldr: Venus in the 8th house: love, pleasure, and values flow toward intimacy, shared resources, and transformation
body: Venus in the 8th house: love, pleasure, and values flow toward intimacy, shared resources, and transformation. Gift: ease and charm there. Watch: indulgence or avoidance. With Venus in the 8th house, love, attraction, pleasure, beauty, values, harmony, and the way you receive move through shared resources, trust, intimacy, debt, grief, and deep repair. This makes how you merge, trust, release control, and handle what cannot stay superficial a central part of the life. Used consciously, this placement can become warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support. Left unconscious, it can become people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area.
gift: warmth, charm, ease, aesthetic intelligence, relational grace, and the ability to attract support expressed through shared depth and vulnerability.
challenge: people-pleasing, indulgence, avoidance of conflict, or measuring worth by approval in this area concentrated in shared depth and vulnerability.
note: Merged with approved project planet-through-house material; source file was not copied into the repository.
